No cumulative height ratchet exceeds those bounds. Existing independent currents keep their actual behavior. There is no unlimited automatic conveyor after a single Action; without a new operation the magic only maintains the currently supported chosen shape. It can hold the selected finite water, not block an entire unselected river or create a vacuum that deletes incoming water. NEW a freely floating body/boat supported by the moved water follows its actual buoyancy and clearance; no weightless lift beyond its existing displacement/support or passage through a real anchor is created. A free boat’s actual operating helmsman may instead make a DEX check with one genuinely applicable water-vehicle proficiency against spell DC, Core success/failure, for the whole boat; no fictional helmsman, control channel or repeated passenger saves.
